ios.desc:
An application (sub-application) platform for quick and efficient problems solving in 3 areas of life: work, personal life, and hobbies.

What's special about SFERA

1. All-in-one. You do not need to install several applications for different tasks and sign up in each of them.

2. Single ID. The ID that you receive upon registration gives you access to all sub-applications’ features. We do not ask for your phone number and email address.

3. Meeting basic needs in sub-applications*

The "Main profile" serves for self-expression, receiving recognition, and self-realization. Speak about yourself and your activities, add photos. Publish original content and build connections with subscribers. Use "Main profile" as your personal blog and grow your audience.

“Choose” will help you to quickly solve your choice problem. To start your survey, you need to answer questions from other users.

If you want to speak out, share something, or ask for advice, go to Black Box. Ask a question, set up filters, and place the box on an interactive map. When a suitable interlocutor is found, a dialogue will begin.

MeetNet will find the perfect partner for a long-term relationship. More info in the information questionnaire and compatibility test increases your chances of finding the most suitable person.

4. App installation and functionality are free.

5. Only real users. One ID is linked to one device. No fakes and bots.

quotes.text:
Our team is developing the SFERA digital ecosystem with various functional services. The concept is that all content should be useful, and each service should be aimed at solving problems in real life.

As well we have taken another approach to implement many services on one platform which is to make all SFERA features available through a single icon on the desktop of your device. Our product is not an app store, but much more than a super app.

We invite you to evaluate our view on the new generation of social networks.

Since we took on the creation of a fundamentally new product, we did not have the opportunity to rely on the experience of others. I had to solve a lot of problems regarding the architecture of the application. In the six months since the release of the application’s first version, we have significantly improved app performance and its stable operation. In order to continue to improve the product, we need to expand the community of testers.

Currently, the SFERA digital ecosystem includes the ASAP messenger (the link between all services), the MeetNet dating service, the Choose Instant Questionnaire, the anonymous Black Box community, the VideoS service for short videos, Find Friends for finding friends, and the publications feed.
